rule: any parameter measured above its Device_Specs static_spec_max at the scored epoch
limits_available: 11 of 18 variant x parameter cells; the other seven stay empty and the rule never fires there
honest_statement: 0 false positives in 5076 normal components. Zero observed errors does not mean a zero rate: with none observed, the 95% one-sided upper bound is 0.06%. The correct claim is 'no observed false positive, true rate below 0.06%', not 'never wrong'.
what_it_does_not_do: the rule catches a minority of anomalies on its own and adds no detections the statistical score misses on this release. Its value is certification, not recall: it marks which flags are certain.
